# Appendix B: Reusable Templates

Copy these templates into your lab documentation repository. Replace angle-bracket placeholders.

## ADR template

```markdown
# ADR-<NNN>: <Title>

## Status
Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by ADR-XXX | Rejected

## Date
YYYY-MM-DD

## Context
What problem or force requires a decision?

## Decision
What will we do?

## Consequences
### Positive
-
### Negative
-
### Neutral
-

## Alternatives considered
1. ...
2. ...

## References
- Charter section:
- Related ADRs:
```

## Incident report template

```markdown
# Incident <YYYY-MM-DD>-<short-name>

## Summary
One paragraph.

## Severity
SEV1 | SEV2 | SEV3

## Services affected
| Service | Impact | Class |

## Detection
- How: alert | human | other
- Time detected (UTC):
- Time started (if known):

## Timeline (UTC)
| Time | Event |
|------|-------|
| | |

## Response actions
1.
2.

## Root cause
Confirmed cause:
Contributing factors:

## Resolution
What fixed it?

## Verification
Commands/tests that prove recovery:

## Follow-up actions
| Action | Owner | Due | Done |
|--------|-------|-----|------|
| | | | |

## Lessons
-
```

```

```

```

```

## DR checklist template

```markdown
# DR Drill: <scenario name>

## Scenario
e.g. Loss of edge Proxmox host / Azure region unreachable / ransomware on wiki data

## Goals
- RTO target:
- RPO target:

## Participants
- Operator:
- Date/time start:
- Date/time end:

## Preconditions
- [ ] Backups verified fresh
- [ ] Offsite reachable
- [ ] Break-glass access tested
- [ ] Stakeholders notified (if any)

## Execution steps
| # | Step | Owner | ETA | Actual | Notes |
|---|------|-------|-----|--------|-------|
| 1 | | | | | |
| 2 | | | | | |

## Measured results
| Metric | Target | Actual |
|--------|--------|--------|
| RTO | | |
| RPO | | |
| Data integrity checks | pass | |

## Issues found
1.

## Corrective actions
| Action | Due |

## Sign-off
- Drill successful: Y/N
- Runbook updated: Y/N
```

## How to store templates

Recommended layout:

```text
docs/
  templates/   # pristine copies from this appendix
  adr/
  incidents/
  runbooks/
  catalog/services/
  dr/
```

Keep pristine templates unchanged; copy out when creating instances.
